pages.text: A ship is a normal build turned into a Simulated Contraption by the Physics Assembler. Glue decides which blocks belong, so only glued groups move together.
Physics Assembler. More Simulated parts are in JEI.

Select a group with Super Glue or Honey Glue, then hold right-click on the assembler and pull the lever. Blocks along diagonal edges are included. Once built, any Physics Assembler can disassemble the ship, and the ship stays fully usable: walk on it, open chests, run machines.
pages.title: Assembling
Honey Glue
pages.text: Click two corners and ctrl-scroll to resize. It only joins ships and also takes overlapping Super Glue. Super Glue does not take Honey Glue.
Blocks have different weights. Some are light, super heavy, slippery or fragile. Sections that lose their connection split off as separate ships, and a Slime Ball merges any two.
pages.title: Weight and splitting
Swivel Bearing
pages.text: Turns the glued group in front of it into a rotating sub-ship. Rotation passes through the shaft. Redstone unlocks it to spin freely.

pages.title: Docking Connector
pages.text: Two connectors align and lock into a rigid link. Items and fluids can then pass both ways. Retract either to undock.

pages.title: Rope Winch
pages.text: Link ships with a Rope Coupling between a winch and a connector. Rotation reels the rope in and out. Shears cut it.
Bearings must be told not to disassemble when used with Steering Wheels or Torsion Springs. Springs let a bearing swing within an angle and return when the input stops.
